```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, MCI, tmap, ggstatsplot)
```

## 1. Importing the geospatial data

```{r}
stores <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "STORES_TC")
```

```{r}
town <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "TOWN_TC")
```

```{r}
village <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "VILLAGE_TC")
```

## 2. Importing the aspatial data

```{r}
pop2019 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/pop2019.csv")
store_sales <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Store_sales_data.csv")
```

```{r}
summary(store_sales)
```

## 3. Aggregating store sales

```{r}
store_sales_aggre <- store_sales %>%
  group_by(`Store Code`) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total_Bill" = sum(Bills, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Total_Sales" = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## 4. Tidying the store data

```{r}
stores_tidied <- stores %>%
  left_join(store_sales_aggre,
            by = join_by(
              Store_CD == `Store Code`)) %>%
  mutate(Store_size = 1) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

summary(stores_tidied)
```

## 5. Tidying the population data

```{r}
pop2019 <- pop2019 %>%
  mutate(V_ID = str_remove_all(
    V_ID, "-"))

village <- village %>%
  left_join(pop2019,
            by = join_by(
              VILLCODE == V_ID))
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_CNT))

c(H_CNT = any(is.na(village$H_CNT)),
  P_CNT = any(is.na(village$P_CNT)),
  M_CNT = any(is.na(village$M_CNT)),
  F_CNT = any(is.na(village$F_CNT)))
```

## 6. Computing the distance matrix

```{r}
village_center <- st_point_on_surface(village)
distmat <- st_distance(village_center, stores)
```

```{r}
rownames(distmat) <- village$VILLCODE
colnames(distmat) <- stores$Store_CD

distmat_long <- distmat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "VILLCODE") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -VILLCODE,
    names_to = "Store_CD",
    values_to = "distance") %>%
  mutate(distance = as.numeric(distance))
```

## 7. Building the interaction matrix

```{r}
ijMatrix <- distmat_long %>%
  left_join(
    stores_tidied %>%
      select(Store_CD, Store_size),
    by = "Store_CD") %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
village_tidied <- village %>%
  select(VILLCODE, H_CNT, P_CNT) %>%
  mutate(HH_SIZE = P_CNT / H_CNT) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
ijMatrix <- ijMatrix %>%
  left_join(
    village_tidied,
    by = "VILLCODE") %>%
  relocate(
    HH_SIZE, .after = last_col())

glimpse(ijMatrix)
```

## 8. Computing the Huff model

```{r}
huff_share <- huff.shares(
  ijMatrix, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD",
  "Store_size", "distance")
```

## 9. Trade area of store BT

```{r}
market_share <- huff_share %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")

Trade_area <- village %>%
  left_join(market_share)

selected_store <- stores %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
tm_shape(Trade_area) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "p_ij",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Patronage Probability")) +
  tm_shape(selected_store) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.3,
            fill = "red",
            col = "black") +
  tm_title("Distribution of Patronage Probability of Store BT by village") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## 10. Estimating store sales

```{r}
huff_share_pp <- huff_share %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())

huff_total <- shares.total(
  huff_share_pp, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD",
  "p_ij", "P_CNT")
```

```{r}
store_sales_est <- stores %>%
  left_join(store_sales_aggre,
            by = join_by(Store_CD == `Store Code`)) %>%
  left_join(huff_total,
            by = join_by(
              "Store_CD" == "suppliers_single"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
store_sales_nongeom <- store_sales_est %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

ggscatterstats(
  store_sales_nongeom,
  x = sum_E_j,
  y = Total_Sales)
```

## 11. Delineating the trade areas

```{r}
huff_share_wider <- huff_share %>%
  select(VILLCODE, Store_CD, p_ij) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Store_CD,
              values_from = p_ij)
```

```{r}
huff_TA <- huff_share_wider %>%
  mutate(
    TA = names(pick(2:29))[
      max.col(pick(2:29),
              ties.method = "first")])
```

```{r}
huff_TA_tidied <- huff_TA %>%
  select(VILLCODE, TA)

village_TA <- village %>%
  left_join(huff_TA_tidied,
            by = join_by(VILLCODE))
```

## 12. Mapping the trade areas

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9
tm_shape(village_TA) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "TA") +
  tm_title("Trade Areas of stores") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## 13. Trade areas with one colour per store

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9
tm_shape(village_TA) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "TA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
                values = "poly.palette36")) +
  tm_shape(stores) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.2,
            fill = "black") +
    tm_text("Store_CD",
            size = 0.6,
            ymod = -0.6) +
  tm_title("Trade Areas of stores") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```
